posts.title: Moving into AI Product Engineering
posts.description: A fellow Whitman alum recently sent me a message asking about my move from leading the feature flags team (“traditional” product engineering) into doing AI product engineering at PostHog. He, like me, had begun his career primarily doing backend engineering, but he was studying AI and considering a similar transition into applied AI work.
